description: A user-supplied photograph of the 2002 book's front cover. The cover preserves the publication title, subtitle and author credit and serves as provenance for the two Pauline Weaver drawings supplied with it. The historical photograph reproduced on the cover is not identified in the visible cover text; its location, date, photographer and original holding institution remain unverified, so the cover is cataloged as source documentation rather than as an identified historical photograph.
